model.title: Next-Generation Geothermal Research and Development Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee, Natural Resources Committee, Science, Space, and Technology Committee · Rep. Pat Harrigan (R-NC)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Department of Energy to support research and development of advanced geothermal energy systems, particularly closed-loop systems that operate in extreme conditions, through grants and demonstration projects. It would also establish a center of excellence for next-generation geothermal technology, expand a repository of geothermal drilling data to include information from fossil fuel and mining operations, and authorize the Interior Department to drill exploratory boreholes to map geothermal resources.
